name: mezmo
description: Check Claude Code's tool calls with Mezmo Governance, and send Claude Code telemetry to Mezmo.

governance_access_key.title: Mezmo Governance access key
governance_access_key.description: Access key of the agent registered for Claude Code in Mezmo Governance. Leave empty to keep governance off. With a key, every tool call is checked before it runs.

governance_url.title: Mezmo Governance URL
governance_url.description: Authorize endpoint. Leave empty for https://api.mezmo.com/governance/workflow/authorize. Development: https://api.use.dev.mezmo.it/governance/workflow/authorize

governance_enabled.title: Check tool calls with Mezmo Governance
governance_enabled.description: Turn off to let tool calls run without a governance check. Governance from managed settings still applies.
